## Description

Calibrates a statistical proxy-chain hop via OLS regression with a lead-lag search (`python/correlation.py`), reporting beta, R-squared, the lag that maximizes fit, and a 95% confidence interval. Never runs against an engineering hop — that classification happens before calibration, per `docs/guidelines/proxy-chain-hop-classification.md`, not as part of this skill. Use when: "calibrate a proxy hop", "lead-lag regression", "unit conversion coefficient", "beta calibration for a proxy chain".
